title: Past Policy, Present Markets
goal: Link past economic decisions to present market conditions with mixed conditionals.
grammar: mixed conditionals (si + pluperfect subjunctive, simple conditional)

items: I can pair *si* + pluperfect subjunctive with the simple conditional to connect a past policy choice to a present outcome.
I can distinguish present-result mixed conditionals (*hoy sería*) from past-result counterfactuals (*habría sido*).
I can discuss public finances and household debt using *el déficit*, *el impuesto*, *la hipoteca* and *la liquidez*.
